title: How many drivers from the UN participated in the 2008 Australian Grand Prix
question: How many drivers from the UN participated in the 2008 Australian Grand Prix?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.driverId)
FROM drivers_results AS T1
INNER JOIN races AS T2
  ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
  AND T2.year = 2008
  AND T1.nationality = 'United Kingdom'
